title: Satisfying extension
statement: Given a DNF term $T$ on $n$ coordinates, a coordinate restriction $\rho$, and a set of positions among the literals of $T$, the satisfying extension is the restriction obtained by fixing the coordinates selected at those positions according to a satisfying assignment of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A set of literal positions in $T$
caveat: The definitions of the coordinate-fixing operation, selected coordinates, and satisfying assignment are absent, so their exact behavior cannot be recovered from this snippet.
